[I84](frontier/iterations/i84-abstract-close-algebras.md) proves abstract nonisomorphism for the actual close-algebra examples. [I87](frontier/reviews/i87-abstract-close-algebras-r2.md) passes the original proof without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I88](frontier/iterations/i88-nonlinear-banach-discovery.md) gives technical support-size and qualitative rank bounds, but leaves the quantitative rank target open; parent evidence checks pass. [I90](frontier/iterations/i90-anchored-rank-approximation.md) passes the original I88 proofs without repairs and proposes an exponential rank bound through weighted pairwise continuation and clipped discrepancy transfer. Parent evidence reproduction passes. [I92](frontier/reviews/i92-anchored-rank-approximation-r2.md) passes the original Q90 proof and all stated variants without repairs; parent evidence reproduction passes. [I93](frontier/reviews/i93-anchored-rank-approximation-novelty-r3.md) classifies Q90 as technical through a complete source-operation/Auerbach/TV reduction; parent evidence reproduction passes. The original proof pass is retained without a count increment. [I94](frontier/iterations/i94-topology-transformation-discovery.md) gives author-level technical nonextension and even-stabilization threshold deductions; parent evidence reproduction passes. Its sharp relative involution target on V#2(S²×S²) remains unproved and unrefuted. [I97](frontier/iterations/i97-relative-involution-stabilization.md) passes original A/B without repairs and adds author-level technical restrictions on the residual product geometry and an exact cut-defect budget; parent evidence replay passes. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted. [I100](frontier/iterations/i100-defect-tolerant-topology-obstruction.md) passes original C/D/E and the scoped complement/Whitney claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new technical residual presentation and periodic localization do not improve the stabilization bound, and an exact algebraic counterexample blocks rank-only tensor extensions. R94 remains unproved and unrefuted; the branch is parked pending new geometric control. [I103](frontier/iterations/i103-algebraic-complexity-discovery.md) gives complete author-level positive-characteristic rational hitting lists and an every-field 9/4 matrix-multiplication exponent transfer, both classified technical by its concrete source-operation comparison. [I106](frontier/iterations/i106-positive-characteristic-imm.md) passes all original constructions and scoped counterexamples without repairs and independently confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. [I109](frontier/iterations/i109-modular-imm-rank.md) passes all original I106 partials and scoped obstructions without repairs and confirms their technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible periodic minors and exact excursion-rank decomposition remain too small for the circuit target. The full excursion degeneration has exponentially deficient rank in characteristic two; this is not an upper bound on full IMM rank. The all-prime target remains unproved and unrefuted, and this construction branch is parked. [I112](frontier/iterations/i112-inverse-boundary-discovery.md) gives author-level technical cap-transfer, physical-jet lifting and local rigidity results, plus a known-collar uniqueness reduction and scoped gauge/boundary-cost obstructions. Parent evidence replay passes. Arbitrary same-patch recovery of both Lamé coefficients remains unproved/unrefuted; the physical augmented jet space has dimension 32 versus 36 for unrestricted system jets. [I115](frontier/iterations/i115-physical-elasticity-continuation.md) preserves two original failures: G112 standalone invertibility needs boundary on every component, and R112 equal-coefficient normalization fails when the equal coefficient is λ=0. The surviving scoped claims pass. New cap construction, fourth-order physical moment closure and conditional comparison rigidity remain author-level technical results. Parent evidence and an independently rebuilt 165×165 determinant certificate pass. [I118](frontier/iterations/i118-physical-quotient-angular.md) passes original I115 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its new author-level technical results give a sharp physical quotient norm criterion, a local evaluation representative and conditional frontier continuation. The nonnormal physical boundary symbol and an uncontrolled trace-kernel component prevent importing the scalar estimate. [I121](frontier/iterations/i121-physical-transfer-bound.md) passes original I118 without repairs at its stated scopes; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work gives frozen accretivity, exact quotient coordinates and the physical boundary Cauchy-defect formula. Neither developed attempt bounds the actual continued flux uniformly. P112 remains unproved/unrefuted; both physical-transfer and expanding-Runge branches are parked pending a new mechanism. [I124](frontier/iterations/i124-fractal-incidence-discovery.md) passes original I121 N1–N16/F1–F12 without repairs at their stated scopes and confirms the technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. Its fresh planar pinned-distance target remains unproved/unrefuted. Fibrewise reconstruction and mass-sensitive tube bounds are author-level technical bridges; an actual Frostman construction defeats a proposed uniform local-energy bound, not pinned positivity. [I127](frontier/iterations/iteration127-diagonal-pinned-distance-task.json) audits these claims and pursues diagonal-pin oscillation and adaptive multiscale estimates. [I91](frontier/iterations/i91-finite-cat0-obstruction.md) passes the used I89 contraction prerequisites without repairs and proposes explicit finite CAT(0) contraction constants via fixed-scale geometry and a 29-point rational certificate. Parent evidence and exact certificate replay pass. [I95](frontier/reviews/i95-finite-cat0-obstruction-r2.md) passes the original Q91 proof and action-to-certificate implication without repairs; parent evidence and independent reconstruction pass. [I96](frontier/reviews/i96-finite-cat0-obstruction-novelty-r3.md) classifies the full Q91 theorem as technical through a complete source-operation reduction and a 12-point scalar contradiction; parent evidence replay passes and I95 resolves its proof condition. The arbitrary K3-family Oka-map target remains unproved and unrefuted; [I102](frontier/iterations/i102-relative-k3-oka-construction.md) passes original A98/W98 and both method obstructions without repairs, at the precise reduced-space interpolation scope. Parent evidence replay passes. Its compatible whole-central-slice germ, conditional relative sewing and adaptive exhaustion criterion remain technical; the fixed-domain extension is missing and R98 is parked unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence replay passes; the blockwise Galois Alperin weight target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I108](frontier/iterations/i108-galois-tuple-divisibility.md) passes all original I104 claims without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. [I110](frontier/iterations/i110-galois-moment-cancellation.md) passes the original finite-moment criterion and constrained-puncture/index claims without repairs; parent replay passes. New exact fixed-label reconstruction, 56 finite moment certificates, a uniform A5×A divisibility bound for odd-order abelian A, and equivariant nontrivial local-point pairing are technical partials. Arbitrary admissible cancellation and G104 remain unproved/unrefuted; the trivial local-point component is unpaid and the branch is parked. Parent evidence replay passes. Unequal-temperature constrained entropy power stability remains unproved and unrefuted: the direct entropy-to-balance step is not established there, and the linear-qEPI deficit is positive even at its thermal optimizer. [I117](frontier/iterations/i117-bosonic-entropy-stability.md) passes original I114 at its stated scopes without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work proves same-input deficit transfer and finite-energy optimizer uniqueness. Exact-constraint rare tails disprove both weighted and ordinary deficit-to-balance moduli and exclude power exponents above 1/2. Its new author-level technical theorem gives an explicit double-logarithmic trace-distance bound on the original finite-energy constraint set. A direct entropy-growth remainder and a fully constrained displaced-tail test leave every possible power exponent at most 1/2 unresolved. [I123](frontier/iterations/i123-thermal-production-stability.md) passes all original I120 paid claims without repairs, preserving the conditional scope of the production implication; parent evidence replay passes. New author-level technical work resolves the nonsmooth entropy-growth measure and constructs an exact-constraint higher-moment obstruction. Varying the auxiliary instrument exposes a filter/frequency tradeoff but no power bound. Target B remains unproved/unrefuted and the thermal branch is parked pending a new coercivity mechanism. [I126](frontier/iterations/iteration126-random-geometry-discovery-task.json) audits these partials, then begins fresh random-geometry discovery. [I99](frontier/iterations/i99-quantitative-arithmetic-patterns-discovery.md) gives author-level joint-kernel estimates, sharp transfer obstructions and a coefficient-explicit counting bridge; parent evidence replay passes. Its uniform nonlinear Roth target remains unproved and unrefuted. [I101](frontier/iterations/i101-two-scale-nonlinear-roth.md) passes original A1–A5/B1–B4 and the scoped counterexamples without repairs; parent evidence replay passes. Its short-window graph bounds, actual parabolic matrix comparison and block-conditioned counts remain technical. C99 is parked unproved and unrefuted pending the precise deterministic block comparison (U). Parent evidence replay passes. [I111](frontier/reviews/i111-rational-tail-attachment-r2.md) passes every component of the original full proof without repairs, including the uniform limit, actual detector injection and under/over compatibility, and independently confirms its technical disposition. Parent evidence replay passes; R105 is technically closed under the stipulated premises and no finding is added. [I113](frontier/iterations/i113-online-optimization-discovery.md) gives an author-level technical one-sample matroid-prophet guarantee of 2⁻²⁹⁵K⁻²⁷ under two-sided likelihood-ratio misspecification, one-sided impossibility examples, and exact stochastic Blackwell policy extraction. Parent evidence replay passes. [I116](frontier/iterations/i116-robust-prophet-continuation.md) passes every original I113 component without repairs and confirms its technical disposition; parent evidence replay passes. **[R012 — uniform Gaussian propeller stability](frontier/findings/R012-uniform-gaussian-propeller-stability.md) is accepted as the sixth substantial finding.** Its deficit controls squared distance to a three-sector propeller with one constant for every dimension and finite cell count, without cell-mass constraints. The original proof passes independent review without repairs; the final significance review judges the control of disappearing labels substantial. Parent reproduction passes. The distance exponent is sharp, the constant is implicit, and worldwide priority remains uncertified. I39 records an unresolved Haldane-disorder gap. I41 independently passes I40’s technical Gaussian waiting-time deduction without repairs; I42 likewise passes I41’s technical four-time comparison and supporting partial results without repairs. The Rademacher fair-start density bound remains open. I45 independently passes I44’s attributed symmetric equality argument and its three supporting results without repairs. Symmetric equality is technically closed under the pinned premises, with full Liu–Sun–Xiong attribution. I47 independently passes I46’s facet-independent planar exponent-10 stability proof without repairs. I48 classifies it as technical, giving an explicit reduction through classical planar geometry and weighted dual Cheeger estimates. [R013 — higher-dimensional logarithmic stability](frontier/findings/R013-higher-dimensional-logarithmic-stability.md) is now accepted as the seventh substantial finding: I50 passes I49’s original proof without repairs, I51 judges the contribution substantial, and parent reproduction passes. For arbitrary ball-bounded symmetric convex bodies in every fixed dimension n≥3, the logarithmic deficit controls a finite power of distance to common complementary-block dilation pairs, with exponent depending only on dimension. I52 records finite-time and conditional standard-map entropy deductions. I54 now proposes the constant additive-loss theorem through a quantitative initial scale and the pinned limiting contradiction, plus a restricted tangent-direction estimate. I57 passes the original additive-entropy proof and restricted projective estimates without repairs; parent reproduction passes. I58 classifies the bound and restricted estimates as technical consequences of the accepted source operations; parent reproduction passes, so this route does not increase the substantial count. I55 passes I53’s original fixed-dimensional Wasserstein stability proof without repairs. I56 classifies it as technical, with a full reduction through classical tensor regularity; both parent replays pass. I59 records averaged normalization and compatibility estimates, a dependent radial-family bound, and explicit obstructions; the dimension-uniform entropy target remains unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence reproduction passes. I61 proposes a dimension-independent coefficient-extraction estimate using paired spectral equations, plus a repair preserving bounded coefficient energy. I63 passes the original theorem, repair and scoped supporting results without repairs. I64 judges the uniform coefficient bridge substantial; both parent reproductions pass. [R014 — dimension-uniform coefficient extraction](frontier/findings/R014-uniform-coefficient-extraction.md) is accepted as the eighth substantial finding. Global algebra rounding and the unrestricted entropy theorem remain open. I60 closes its slice transfer as technical, refutes three stronger proposals and leaves the same-density two-union integral-cover target open. Parent evidence reproduction passes. I62 completes bounded-rank covers and explicit obstructions to two attempted general constructions; its same-density two-union target remains unproved and unrefuted. Parent evidence checks pass, with no substantial nomination. The delayed I29 common-base entropy report also completes a sharp technical corollary, with parent reproduction passing and no count increment. Two further substantial findings remain.

**[R009 — variable-channel reconstruction capacity](frontier/findings/R009-variable-channel-capacity.md).** A weighted nonlinear capacity characterizes four-state reconstruction on locally finite trees with arbitrary known edge channels, including perfect transmission. Independent proof and prior-art reviews pass; the parent reproduced their checks. The degree-free extension belongs to the same finding. Worldwide priority remains unverified.
